description: This is a test class for the StartupErrorFilter in the OpenMRS web application, verifying its behavior related to startup errors and their handling.

classes.name: StartupErrorFilterTest
classes.description: Test class for StartupErrorFilter, containing setup, teardown, and test methods verifying filter behavior based on startup errors.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of StartupErrorFilter before each test.

methods.name: reverterrorAtStartup
methods.description: Resets the errorAtStartup field in Listener to null after each test.

methods.name: getModel_shouldReturnAStartupErrorFilterModelContainingTheStartupError
methods.description: Verifies that the filter correctly fetches the startup error model when an error is set.

methods.name: skipFilter_shouldReturnTrueIfNoErrorHasOccuredOnStartup
methods.description: Checks that skipFilter returns true when there has been no startup error.

methods.name: skipFilter_shouldReturnFalseIfAnErrorHasOccuredOnStartup
methods.description: Checks that skipFilter returns false when a startup error is present.
